title: Corylifol A alleviates rheumatoid arthritis by targeting HSP90alpha and suppressing Wnt/beta-catenin signaling.
authors: Zhang, Ruojia; Fan, Huancai; Dong, Zhuoyuan; Feng, Tingting; Zhu, Zhenwei; Ge, Luna; Zhang, Yu'ang; Song, Guanhua; Zhang, Yeyong; Wang, Lin; Han, Jinxiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药单体Corylifol A通过靶向HSP90alpha抑制Wnt信号治疗类风湿关节炎，涉及分子对接但核心是药物-蛋白互作与疾病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic autoimmune disease characterized by persistent synovial inflammation and progressive joint destruction. Although methotrexate (MTX) remains a first-line therapy for RA, its clinical use may be limited by inadequate response, secondary loss of efficacy, and adverse effects, highlighting the need for safer and more effective therapeutic strategies. Corylifol A (CA), a bioactive monomer derived from traditional Chinese medicine, has been reported to exert immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory effects; however, its therapeutic role and underlying mechanisms in RA remain insufficiently understood. In this study, THP-1-Lucia NF-kappaB reporter cells were used to screen traditional Chinese medicine-derived monomers with anti-inflammatory potential, and CA was selected for further evaluation in RA fibroblast-like synoviocytes (RA FLSs) and experimental arthritis models. Integrated transcriptomic and network pharmacology analyses were performed to identify the potential molecular targets and pathways involved in the therapeutic effects of CA in RA. CA significantly inhibited the proliferation, migration, invasion, and inflammatory cytokine production of RA FLSs, while alleviating inflammation and bone destruction in arthritic mice. Mechanistically, CA inactivated heat shock protein 90 alpha (HSP90alpha) and consequently suppressed downstream Wnt signaling. Molecular docking and Asp93 mutation-based rescue experiments further suggested that Asp93 may be involved in the interaction between CA and HSP90alpha. Moreover, CA enhanced the therapeutic effects of MTX, resulting in more obvious suppression of RA FLSs inflammatory activation and arthritis progression in vivo. These findings suggest that CA may represent a potential therapeutic candidate for RA, and the enhanced therapeutic effects observed with CA plus MTX further support its therapeutic relevance.
abstract_zh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种慢性自身免疫性疾病，其特征为持续性滑膜炎症和进行性关节破坏。尽管甲氨蝶呤（MTX）仍是RA的一线治疗药物，但其临床应用可能受到反应不足、继发性疗效丧失及不良反应的限制，凸显了对更安全有效治疗策略的需求。Corylifol A（CA）是一种源自中药的生物活性单体，据报道具有免疫调节和抗炎作用；然而，其在RA中的治疗作用及潜在机制仍未被充分阐明。本研究使用THP-1-Lucia NF-kappaB报告细胞筛选具有抗炎潜力的中药来源单体，并选择CA在RA成纤维样滑膜细胞（RA FLSs）和实验性关节炎模型中进行进一步评估。通过整合转录组学和网络药理学分析，以识别CA在RA中治疗效应所涉及的潜在分子靶点和通路。CA显著抑制RA FLSs的增殖、迁移、侵袭及炎症细胞因子产生，同时减轻关节炎小鼠的炎症和骨破坏。机制上，CA使热休克蛋白90α（HSP90alpha）失活，并因此抑制下游Wnt信号通路。分子对接和基于Asp93突变的拯救实验进一步提示，Asp93可能参与CA与HSP90alpha之间的相互作用。此外，CA增强了MTX的治疗效果，在体内导致对RA FLSs炎症激活和关节炎进展的更显著抑制。这些发现表明，CA可能代表RA的潜在治疗候选药物，且CA联合MTX观察到的增强治疗效果进一步支持其治疗相关性。
